title: I Let the Skatepark Helmet Cam Catch the Coach Who Skipped the Strap

parts.text: I clipped in at 4:16 p.m. and coach Dez dropped into the bowl with the strap undone. The gate sign said: STRAP ON. CAMERAS RUN. COACHES TOO. I was nineteen, park regular, holding a day wristband. Dez laughed. "Coaches are the bowl." I photographed the undone strap, the sign, and the cam LED. Then I logged a skip. At 4:22 parks rec asked why Dez's helmet was on an unstrapped still. I asked once, then I documented twice. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Parks rec can see Dez's undone strap on the cam LED against the gate sign.

social.video_title: The coach dropped in with the strap undone — Part 1/2
social.description: Skatepark, a gate sign, and a coach's laugh. I logged the skip. Would you have photographed the LED?

parts.text: Dez called it style until rec asked for the still. I printed the skip, the photo, and the sign. He strapped. Dez coached from the deck until the clip clicked and told kids style was always about optics. Optics is a word coaches use when a cam exists. Helmet policy now has a second line: COACHES CLIP. I keep my strap. Dez clicks. The bowl finally looks like a park, not a stunt. The room sounds like a room again, not a title. Petty is a word people use when their name is on the ticket.

social.description: Skip still, clipped strap, and a second line. Was style ever an undone buckle?
